steps.text: There's more in PocketBudJet. On Activity, tap the three dots, then Calendar view.
Your bills and paydays, day by day.
Tap back, then Toolbox. Under Plan, tap Tax Filing Export.
It gets your year ready for taxes, sorted the way the tax forms ask.
Widgets & Watch puts your numbers on your home screen and your watch.
Under Earn, Company filings brings news from the companies you invest in.
Under Spend, tap Import Center, then Forward email confirmations.
On a computer, email a statement in, and it shows up here.
It opens your budget on a computer on the same Wi-Fi.
Tap back, then Household & Partner Sync.
Share one budget with your partner, phone to phone.
And on Goals, Track a debt adds a credit card, so you see what it really costs and how fast you can pay it off.
